description.value: You've immersed yourself in your people's history and culture. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Additional Lore] general feat for Verthani Lore.
